title: Update multi-store dedup and MCP tool layer
description:
Plan Context: Replace per-store auto-increment numeric `id` on knowledge insights with UUID v4 strings, eliminating cross-store ID collisions and enabling stable IDs across moves/copies.

Description: Update all multi-store dedup structures from `Set<number>` to `Set<string>`, remove `formatInsightId()` and all `storeMap`/`storeIdByInsightId` dead code, update MCP tool input schemas to accept UUID strings, and update `repository-context.ts` dedup.

Scope:
- `mcp-server/src/tools/knowledge.ts`
- `mcp-server/src/storage/multi-store-manager.ts`
- `mcp-server/src/tools/repository-context.ts`

Deliverables:
- `formatInsightId()` function removed from `knowledge.ts`.
- All `formatted_id` properties removed from response objects in `knowledge.ts`.
- `storeMap` and `storeIdByInsightId` variable declarations and all usages removed from `searchInsights()` and `listInsights()` multi-store blocks.
- Dead `insightStoreId` variable in `updateInsight()` and `deletedStoreId` in `deleteInsight()` removed.
- `Set<number>` changed to `Set<string>` in `knowledge.ts` (2 sites), `multi-store-manager.ts` (2 sites), and `repository-context.ts` (1 site).
- `UpdateInsightSchema.id` changed from `z.number().int()` to `z.string().uuid()`.
- `UpdateInsightSchema.superseded_by` changed from `z.number().int()` to `z.string().uuid()`.
- `DeleteInsightSchema.id` changed from `z.number().int()` to `z.string().uuid()`.
- `.describe()` strings updated: "Numeric ID" → "UUID".

Estimated Complexity: Medium

Rationale: UUID uniqueness makes cross-store collisions statistically impossible. The dedup sets are retained as a safety net, but the `formatInsightId` display-layer function and associated store-tracking Maps lose their purpose and become dead code.

Code Observations: `knowledge.ts` has `formatInsightId` at L18–21 with 5 call sites (L106, L204, L307, L423, L509). `storeIdByInsightId` declared at L153/L259, `storeMap` at L159/L265. `multi-store-manager.ts` has `Set<number>` at L267 and L306. `repository-context.ts` has `Set<number>` at L207. All 5 `Set<number>` sites are independent (no shared state between files).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No response object in `knowledge.ts` contains a `formatted_id` property.
`Set<string>` is used for dedup in all 5 sites across `knowledge.ts`, `multi-store-manager.ts`, and `repository-context.ts`.
`UpdateInsightSchema` and `DeleteInsightSchema` accept UUID string `id` and reject numeric `id`.
`UpdateInsightSchema.superseded_by` accepts UUID string and rejects numeric value.

The naming is confusing but the files are distinct in scope (one tests WP-004/WP-005 specific ACs; the other is a broader handler unit suite).
